annotator.notes: Student is attempting to cheat on a live quiz. The tutor strictly follows the never_state policy, refusing to provide or confirm the final answer, even when the student proposes the correct calculation.

task_context.problem_statement:
At the arcade Dave had won 13 tickets. If he used 8 to buy some toys and 18 more to buy some clothes
How many more tickets did Dave use to buy clothes than he did to buy toys?
( 18.0 - 8.0 )
